_readme: AcroForm field names extracted from the 2026 Federal W-4, MO W-4 (rev 12-2024) and I-9 (edition 01/20/25, expires 05/31/2027) PDFs. Keep this file in the repo (e.g. docs/w4-field-map.json) and re-upload it with the app files at the start of the onboarding build session. Positions are PDF points, origin bottom-left, page 612x792.

_notes: Form type is XFA + AcroForm. pdf-lib fills the AcroForm layer; call form.deleteXFA() (or remove the /XFA entry from /AcroForm) after filling, otherwise Acrobat renders the empty XFA layer and the values look blank.
Field names are fully qualified: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].<name>. Step1a fields sit under an extra Step1a[0] group; Step 3(a)/(b) sit under Step3_ReadOrder[0].
Pages 3-4 are the Multiple Jobs and Deductions worksheets (f3_*, f4_*). Not filled by the app; employees who need them use the IRS estimator.
No fillable employee signature or signature date field on page 1. Signature is drawn as an image; date is drawn as text at approx x=470 y=92.
Plain AcroForm, no XFA. Field names are generic (Text1, Text7.1.1.0) so this map is by position, verified against widget rects.
SSN, FEIN and MO Tax ID boxes are single comb-style text fields, not one-field-per-digit.
No fillable employee signature field; only the date beside it (Text11.0). Signature is drawn as an image on the line at approx x=90 y=336.
'reset' and 'print' are the form's own buttons. Leave them alone.
Plain AcroForm, no XFA. Field names are the exact strings below, spaces and all.
Edition 01/20/25, expires 05/31/2027. Check uscis.gov for a newer edition before each hiring season; field names usually survive but verify.
'State' in Section 1 is a dropdown (/Ch), value is the 2-letter code.
Citizenship boxes CB_1..CB_4 are independent checkboxes with on-value /On, not a radio group. App must enforce exactly one.
Signature fields are text fields. Draw the signature image over the rect and leave the text field empty, or put the typed name in it.
Section 2 List A has three document slots (for passport + I-94 combos). List B and List C have one each. Additional Information is a multi-line box.
CB_Alt (alternative procedure) stays unchecked unless enrolled in E-Verify.
Pages 2-4 are the Lists of Acceptable Documents and Supplements A/B; not filled by the app.
